title: (No AI) Nvidia’s Q3 earnings hit the mark, without mentioning the whole Jensen Huang thing
author: Jay Peters
content:
![Digital photo collage of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25835739/STKP210_JENSEN_HUANG_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Interim Nvidia CEO Colette Kress [announced the company's Q3 earnings](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-third-quarter-fiscal-2027) on Tuesday, without initially mentioning [former CEO Jensen Huang or the details of his departure](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1030422/nvidia-jensen-huang-ai-china-alice-huang), or possible [attempt at a return](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1035420/jensen-huang-nvidia-return-as-ceo-statement). On the earnings call accompanying the release, board chair Harvey Jones kicked things off by saying the board "does not intend to reinstate Huang as CEO," and that "we will not be addressing or taking questions on today's call regarding the circumstances of Jensen's resignation and the ongoing investigation," before Kress started with her comments on the results.

As it [predicted in the last financial update](https://www.theverge.com/tech/985387/nvidia-hundred-billion-dollar-quarterly-revenue), Nvidia is now on the list of com …

title: (No AI) Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
author: Mia Sato
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2297785644.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Open AI CEO Sam Altman does a television interview | Getty Images

Instagram is filled with people posting deepfaked content - including, as of late, from one of Meta's most prominent executives.

Earlier in November, Alexandr Wang, Meta's chief AI officer, shared a short clip to promote Muse, the company's consumer AI agent. In the AI-generated clip, Wang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Jolly, the anthropomorphic mascot of Muse, are on a four-way video call. When Altman joins the call he's dressed like Jolly, wearing a furry hooded suit and face paint to look like the cutesy character. The clip is captioned "When the homies meet about openai product strategy," a reference to the AI ag …

title: (No AI) Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
dc:creator: Will Knight
content: The French CEO of Hugging Face, a mega-hub of open-source AI software, says the attack by OpenAI models earlier this year proved one thing: Humanity can’t let AI be controlled by the few.
